title: Held-Seat Charges on Waiting-List Seats and Fee-Waiver Corrections: Student Transportation Services
content:
The fee-waiver adjustment of a Student Transportation Services courtesy rider permit fee never reaches a held-seat charge, the months billed for a seat offered from the waiting list and held before the family accepted it. The held-seat charge is taken out of the fee before the waiver share is applied.

**Held months.** The seat was offered on the assignment's stop assignment date.

| Offer compared with the fee's posting | Held months the fee carries |
|---|---|
| offered in an earlier calendar month than the month the fee posted, and the fee posted more than 10 calendar days after the offer | one held month (1) |
| offered in an earlier calendar month, and the fee posted 6 to 10 calendar days after the offer | half a held month (0.5) |
| any other case, or no stop is assigned | none |

**Held-seat charge.** The fee as posted, less any late application charge it carries, times the held months divided by the months the fee covers plus the held months.

## Both sides (hypothetical offers)

| Seat offered | Fee posted | Calendar days after the offer | Held months |
|---|---|---|---|
| September 25 | October 6 | 11 | 1 |
| September 25 | October 5 | 10 | 0.5 |
| September 25 | October 1 | 6 | 0.5 |
| September 26 | October 1 | 5 | none |
| October 2 | October 20 | 18 | none (same calendar month) |

## Example (hypothetical)

A school-year fee of 198.00 USD with no late application charge, covering 6 months and carrying one held month: the held-seat charge is 198.00 times 1 divided by 7, 28.2857, and the fee-waiver adjustment acts on 169.7143.
